description: On each trigger, puts out one random voltage lying between the two voltages you set

params.text: Fires the module once, as a rising edge at the trigger jack does
Multiplies the first voltage after its offset knob has been added, -5 to 5
Multiplies the second voltage after its offset knob has been added, -5 to 5
Adds -5V to 5V to the first voltage before it is multiplied by its scale knob
Adds -5V to 5V to the second voltage before it is multiplied by its scale knob

inputs.text: A rising edge here picks a new random voltage and holds it at the output
One end of the range the random voltage falls in, taken before the offset and scale above it are applied
The other end of the range the random voltage falls in, taken before the offset and scale below it are applied

outputs.text: Holds the random voltage picked at the last trigger until the next one

notes: nothing is computed at all while the output is unpatched, so patch the output first
the two ends of the range can be set from the offset knobs alone, with nothing patched to either input jack

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
